title: Quechua today: a living language in Peru
goal: Report what linguists and speakers say about Quechua, using reporting verbs.
grammar: reporting verbs like afirmar, advertir and negar

items: I can report what experts and speakers say with reporting verbs (*señalar*, *afirmar*, *recordar*, *negar*).
I can say how many people speak Quechua in Peru, according to the census.
I can use the new words for language: *lengua*, *hablante*, *sufijo*, *censo*.
